pairing.heading: Pair with HomeKit
pairing.step1: Open the Home app on your iPhone.
pairing.step3: Scan the QR code, or choose More options and enter the code.
pairing.alreadyPaired: This bridge is already paired. You only need the code to pair again, after you have removed the bridge from the Home app.
pairing.notStarted: The bridge has not started yet.
